scope: CHECK-A-R only: read-only Market/Recovery and parent inspection/cache routing against existing contracts. No UI/browser run, image review, compatibility/performance tests, Game/user-save action, source/Git edits or R4/new-play work.
classificationNote: Confirmed-code-defect means the visible event binding unconditionally reaches the defective source assignment/routing. Browser reproduction and pixel consequences are not claimed; root should capture red cases before repair. Pure visual density observations are separate.

confirmedCodeDefects.title: Reselecting the current shelf object destroys its edited finite authorization draft
actualReachablePath: Lawful qi character at market; 历练 -> 坊市 -> buy-herb.
Edit max7, until target, target17; expand original budget and set100/reserve11.
Click the already selected buy-herb object again.
confirmedCodeDefects.actualByCode: select has no same-id guard and unconditionally sets max1, cycles mode, target=currentStock+1, stone/item reserve0, editedLimits=false, then price*1 budget. For herb this makes budget5.
confirmedCodeDefects.expectedContract: Ordinary same-object viewing must not silently overwrite draft budget/reserve;0013#4 and0014#6 read-only contexts, global AGENTS same-object rule.
confirmedCodeDefects.impact: No immediate Game write; the next explicit start can use a newly weakened reserve/changed target after an innocuous object click. Viewed saved arrangement also loses its original values on reselection.
confirmedCodeDefects.testRequirement: Assert complete draft fields and Game/activity unchanged after same-id reselection in buy and sell; include edited saved-plan view and activity tick/pause, not only default count.
confirmedCodeDefects.repairBoundary: A same-id guard must not suppress explicit restore of a genuinely new saved plan. Buy/sell mode changes need an explicit default/own-draft policy; do not hide or lower finite limits.

confirmedCodeDefects.title: Catalogue changes can leave a hidden selected market object or a selected object on another page
actualReachablePath: At qi market, enable 显示后续坊市货物, page to 道蕴砂 and select buy-dao.
Turn off 后续境界. The handler only sets page=0.
confirmedCodeDefects.actualByCode: rows excludes dao, but item reads C.items[selected] independently of rows, and no future/rows watcher reconciles selected. The high-realm dao object stays in main detail while its shelf disappears. Pagination likewise changes page alone while preserving an off-page selected object. Same-life qi->foundation insertion can shift healing_pill index3->4 without page correction.
confirmedCodeDefects.expectedContract: Current object and actual directory selection must be clear; all current-world context/selected state from0012/0014 and R3 identity fixes establish this precedent.
confirmedCodeDefects.impact: False selection relationship and apparent hidden/phantom object despite correct formal disabled rules. No unauthorized reward/fee.
confirmedCodeDefects.testRequirement: Future-toggle after selecting a hidden high-realm object; normal same-life growth after selecting a boundary item; selected item removed by visibility should choose a real row or give an explicit off-page selection model.
confirmedCodeDefects.repairBoundary: Retain edited authorization for the same still-valid object; only reconcile local selected/page on changed visibility, never clear accepted commands or swap a stored activity.

confirmedCodeDefects.title: The bag sale-arrangement inspection has no return-to-bag context
actualReachablePath: Lawful qi character: 行囊 -> select 回春丹 -> 查看出售安排.
This calls act(SELL), inspectPreparation, inspectPreparationPlan and openHub(market).
confirmedCodeDefects.actualByCode: market is absent from detailViews. openHub treats it as independent navigation, calls selectTab and clears detailParent. closeHub consequently selects 修行/home, rather than restoring prior inventory object. Recovery inspection uses detailViews recovery and does keep the original bag context, so two read-only uses of the same bag object return differently.
confirmedCodeDefects.expectedContract: 0013#4 one ordinary detail surface with return to original page/object/draft;0015#4 use/sale inspection is read-only, not a main-game context switch.
confirmedCodeDefects.impact: No resource effect, but breaks predictable return and requires explicitly re-opening the bag; its own KeepAlive may still preserve the selected object. Distinct root/nested Market instances mean returning to Explore/market is not equivalent to returning to the opened bag-sale view.
confirmedCodeDefects.testRequirement: Bag medicine -> recovery -> close and bag medicine -> sale -> close should both restore the original selected item/category/page with Game/activity unchanged; also check a sale source/goal detail and its return.
confirmedCodeDefects.repairBoundary: Classify market arrangement detail deliberately and test original Explore market path as well. Do not accidentally change actual travel or clear accepted configuration/retry state.

risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.risk: Switching buy->sell->buy invokes select and discards buy draft; switching shelf objects intentionally defaults all fields. A per-mode/per-object draft policy is not presently explicit in0007. Same-object is a definite defect above; broader draft caching should be decided from existing user contract rather than silently expanding implementation.
risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.probe: Custom buy target/budget/reserve -> sell inspection -> buy, compare draft and Game. Confirm intended behavior before treating different-object defaults as a bug.

risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.risk: HP/MP medicines share target/count/reserve refs. Switching to the other medicine changes the object while inheriting all three values; rest monthsReserve is separate. This may be a valid shared recovery policy, or may overwrite an expected per-item draft, but no explicit independent-draft contract was found.
risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.probe: Edit healing target/max/reserve, inspect spirit/rest, return; distinguish semantic reuse from loss. Do not invent new storage or separate activities just to resolve a presentation preference.

risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.risk: Parent inspection emits market-item-* and recovery-* highlights whereas children locate recognizes buy|sell-* and use-* or rest. Current savedPlan restore masks the mismatch for every standard inspectPreparation route; it is not an established user-visible defect.
risksNeedingBrowserEvidence.probe: If touching restoration/highlight routing, test both already-saved and first unsaved USE/REST/BUY/SELL plans, and source navigation paths. Avoid a speculative prefix-only fix that resets edited drafts.

pureVisualObservations.observation: Default surface simultaneously includes mode+money/future,4 shelf cards, object picture+description+source,2-3 always-visible numeric target controls, collapsed budget, estimate/stop and primary action. Existing budgets are finite and summary is visible, so this is information-density observation, not hidden authorization or proven overlap. Root pixels are needed to decide smallest hierarchy correction.

Default surface includes dual body bars,3 choices, supply art, selected explanation, next exact effect/source, visible target%, collapsed dose/reserve, estimate and action. Dose/reserve and rest lifespan finite summaries are already visible. No clipping/illegibility assertion from static source; this audit viewed0 images.

identityAndRuleSafety: Market/Recovery sameSaved compares full currently meaningful plan fields and requires parent planSaved for 已保存 label; editing values makes it unsaved.
App watches activity.id and syncEpoch to revoke preparationInspectionSaved, not every Game revision: same-activity cycle/pause preserves edited draft.
App inspectionOwner checks runId/navigation/sync and original activity id for saved views around awaits; callbacks do not rely on stale revision.

App clearInspections synchronously on runId change plus root Market/Recovery runId keys and nested Explore/Market runId key isolates lives. Child runId watchers alone are not complete resets, but key reconstruction supplies actual boundary.
StartPreparation clears readonly inspection but delegates actual plan to existing Store; no local timer, reward, optimistic Game write, direct use/sale or offline inference.
Travel uses explicit plan clone/arrangeTravel, then restored draft and separate start. No automatic supply acquisition or recovery.
Neither same-object selection nor filters/details call the formal Game engine. Original CAS, accepted command identity and retry paths untouched by readonly inspection clearing.
